title: DEEP SEA EMBERS
Chapter 2  -  The Captain of the Vanished
note: Lines are the chapter's own wording, shortened. 'delivery' is how a line is said; it goes to the voice clone.

duncan.voice_design: A tall man in his early forties with a deep, low, resonant baritone voice; calm, dry and controlled, a ship captain who is quietly unsettled; slightly rough, natural pace.
duncan.voice_ref_text: It seems this body changes every time I pass through that door. The sea is quiet today, and there is still no one aboard this ship but me.

goat.voice_design: A strange old creaky voice, as if carved wood were speaking: hoarse, dry and gravelly, slightly nasal, a talking ship's figurehead; very expressive, able to sound gloomy or fussy and cheerful.
goat.voice_ref_text: Good morning, Captain. The sea is calm, the wind is right, and the ship is waiting for your orders, as always. Did you sleep well?

lines.delivery: muttering to himself, thoughtful and low
lines.text: It seems my body switches every time I pass through the door. If only I could put a camera on this side.
Oh well. At least the recording proved I really walked into the fog.

lines.delivery: hoarse, slow and gloomy, a single cold question
suddenly warm, fast and chatty, cheerful
lines.text: Good morning, Captain! It is good to see that you still remember your name. Did you sleep well? Today is a good day to set sail. The sea is calm, the wind is right...
Oh, of course, Captain! You like quietness, and as your loyal first mate and second mate and lead sailor and scout, I know this very well...
I'm ordering you to be quiet!
Duncan Abnomar. The real owner of this ship must have died a long, long time ago.
Yes, Captain! Today is a good day to set sail, and the Vanished awaits your orders. Shall we raise the sails?
